beats.source_text: a butterfly flying in the garden freely and is happy like it just came out of the cocoon
beats.visual: A bright garden filled with colorful flowers and soft sunlight. A newly emerged butterfly flutters freely through the air, moving from flower to flower with gentle, joyful wingbeats. In the background, an empty cocoon hangs from a nearby branch.
beats.dialogue: A butterfly flies happily through the garden, free and joyful, as if it has just come out of its cocoon.
